newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux in U.S. water supply deal.
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux in U.S. water supply deal.

text.p: French private utilities group Generale des Eaux said on Tuesday its American unit AWT had won a 900 million franc ($160 million) water management contract in the United States.
It said two AWT subsidiaries, PSG and Metcalf & Eddy, would take over water management and modernisation of a plant in Cranston, Rhode Island's second city.
The contract is one of the longest of its kind to be signed with a private water firm in the United States, the French parent said in a statement.
AWT had 1996 turnover of $700 million and had previously signed a water supply contract in Puerto Rico, Generale said.
